title: play-console-mcp
description: Manage Google Play Console: releases, listings, monetization, reviews, and Android Vitals.
summary: Manage Google Play Console: releases, listings, monetization, reviews, and Android Vitals.
offersHint: Manage Google Play Console: releases, listings, monetization, reviews, and Android Vitals. · Packages: npm:@wiseappsai/play-console-mcp · Env vars: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, PLAY_DEVELOPER_ACCOUNT_ID, PLAY_READ_ONLY, PLAY_REPORTS_BUCKET, PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, PLAY_STORAGE_CREDENTIALS, PLAY_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Inline Google service-account key JSON (recommended). Alternatively set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a key file path.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google service-account key file (alternative to PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON).

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_DEVELOPER_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Play developer account id. Required only for the `users` (permissions) toolset.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_REPORTS_BUCKET
environmentVariables.description: Cloud Storage report-export bucket for the `play_reviews_export` and `play_stats_export` tools — the value from Play Console > Download reports > 'Copy Cloud Storage URI' (pubsite_prod_rev_...). Not the developer account id.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_STORAGE_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a credentials JSON used only for the storage/reviews-export client. The report buckets usually can't be granted to a service account; locally `gcloud auth application-default login` is auto-detected instead.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable, or 'all'. Toolsets: releases, store_listing, monetization, commerce, reviews, users, devices, advanced, vitals, reports, workflows.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only actions.
